
```{r}

```

```{r}

```

```{r}

Scaled_copy <- Bayley_Scaled_scores

```

GSV Work:
  - Make month variables easier to work with
  - Pivot Longer
  - Convert B3 to B4
  - Remove 2 month visits
```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
mutate(GSV_copy, redcap_event_name = as.factor(redcap_event_name))

table(GSV_copy$redcap_event_name)

GSV_copy <- GSV_copy %>%
  mutate(redcap_event_name = case_when(redcap_event_name == "2_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 2,
                                 redcap_event_name == "6_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 6,
                                 redcap_event_name == "12_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 12,
                                 redcap_event_name == "24_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 24,
                                 redcap_event_name == "36_month_visit_arm_1" ~ 36))

table(GSV_copy$redcap_event_name)

GSV_copy <- pivot_longer(GSV_copy,
                         cols = starts_with("bsid_gsv"),
                         names_to = "category",
                         values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(category == "bsid_gsv_cog" ~ "Cognitive", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_ec" ~ "Expressive", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_rc" ~ "Receptive", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_gm" ~ "Gross Motor", 
                              category == "bsid_gsv_fm" ~ "Fine Motor"))

GSV_copy <- GSV_copy %>%
  mutate(z_score = (score - 500) / 100) %>%
  mutate(bayley4score = round((z_score * 25) + 500))

GSV_copy <- filter(GSV_copy, redcap_event_name != 2)

table(GSV_copy$redcap_event_name)
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}

set.seed(123)

ggplot(GSV_copy, aes(y = score, x = bsid_age_calc, color = sca_condition))+
  geom_jitter(width = 1.5, height = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Month Visit",
    y = "GSV Score",
    color = "SCA Condition",
    title = "Scores Over Time by SCA Condition and Category") +
  facet_wrap(~ category)

ggplot(GSV_copy, aes(y = score, x = bsid_age_calc, color = sca_condition))+
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Month Visit",
    y = "GSV Score",
    color = "SCA Condition",
    title = "Scores Over Time by SCA Condition and Category") +
  facet_wrap(~ category)

ggplot(GSV_copy, aes(y = score, x = as.factor(redcap_event_name)))+
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(y = "GSV Score",
    x = "Month Visit",
    title = "Scores by Month and Category") +
  facet_wrap(~ category)

```

GAMLSS
```{r}
#make sure that you filter out all of the NA values while keeping as much overall data that you do have as possible.

cog_xxy_data <- GSV_copy %>%
  filter(category == "Cognitive") %>%
  filter(sca_condition == "XXY") %>%
  na.omit()

mform_dt_hgt <- gamlss(
  formula = bayley4score ~ pb(bsid_age_calc, lambda = 5),
  sigma.formula = ~ pb(bsid_age_calc),
  nu.formula = ~1,
  tau.formula = ~1,
  data = cog_xxy_data,
  family = BCCG())

ages <- seq(2, 41, by = 0.5)

new_data <- data.frame(bsid_age_calc = ages)

params <- predictAll(mform_dt_hgt, newdata = new_data)

centiles <- c(10, 25, 50, 75, 90)

q_vals <- sapply(centiles / 100, function(p) {
  qBCCG(p, mu = params$mu, sigma = params$sigma, nu = params$nu)
})

lms_hgt <- data.frame(age = ages, q_vals)

colnames(lms_hgt)[-1] <- paste0("P", centiles)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Assuming lms_hgt is already created as in your code:
# lms_hgt <- data.frame(age = ages, q_vals)
# colnames(lms_hgt)[-1] <- paste0("P", centiles)

# Convert data from wide to long format for ggplot
lms_long <- pivot_longer(
  lms_hgt,
  cols = -age,
  names_to = "Percentile",
  values_to = "Score"
)

# Plotting
ggplot(lms_long, aes(x = age, y = Score, color = Percentile)) +
  geom_smooth(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Growth Chart: Bayley-4 Cognitive Scores by Age (XXY)",
    x = "Age (months)",
    y = "Bayley-4 Cogniitve Score",
    color = "Percentile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```

```{r}
cog_xyy_data <- GSV_copy %>%
  filter(category == "Cognitive") %>%
  filter(sca_condition == "XYY") %>%
  na.omit()

mform_dt_hgt2 <- gamlss(
  formula = bayley4score ~ pb(bsid_age_calc, lambda = 5),
  sigma.formula = ~ pb(bsid_age_calc),
  nu.formula = ~1,
  tau.formula = ~1,
  data = cog_xyy_data,
  family = BCCG())

ages <- seq(2, 41, by = 0.5)

new_data2 <- data.frame(bsid_age_calc = ages)

params2 <- predictAll(mform_dt_hgt2, newdata2 = new_data2)

centiles <- c(10, 25, 50, 75, 90)

q_vals2 <- sapply(centiles / 100, function(p) {
  qBCCG(p, mu = params$mu, sigma = params$sigma, nu = params$nu)
})

lms_hgt2 <- data.frame(age = ages, q_vals2)

colnames(lms_hgt2)[-1] <- paste0("P", centiles)

```

```{r}
lms_long2 <- pivot_longer(
  lms_hgt2,
  cols = -age,
  names_to = "Percentile",
  values_to = "Score"
)

# Plotting

ggplot() +
  # P10 and P90: light grey dashed
  geom_smooth(data = filter(lms_long2, Percentile %in% c("P10", "P90")),
              aes(x = age, y = Score, group = Percentile),
              color = "grey", linetype = "dashed", se = FALSE) +
  # P25 and P75: black dashed
  geom_smooth(data = filter(lms_long2, Percentile %in% c("P25", "P75")),
              aes(x = age, y = Score, group = Percentile),
              color = "black", linetype = "dashed", se = FALSE) +
  # P50: black solid
  geom_smooth(data = filter(lms_long2, Percentile == "P50"),
              aes(x = age, y = Score),
              color = "black", linetype = "solid", se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Growth Chart: Bayley-4 Cognitive Scores by Age (XYY)",
    x = "Age (months)",
    y = "Bayley-4 Cognitive Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
